analyzed_vuln.description: ValidateArrayVisitor::ValidateListArray unconditionally reads both boundary offsets using array.value_offset(0) and array.value_offset(array.length()) after ValidateOffsets(). ValidateOffsets() computes required_offsets as (length > 0) ? length + offset + 1 : 0, so for a sliced/offset list array with length==0 it does not require any offset entries. That allows an empty list array with nonzero array.offset() and too-small offset buffer to pass validation, then value_offset(0) dereferences raw_value_offsets_[data_->offset] out of bounds (heap-buffer-overflow in BaseListArray::value_offset at array.h:589).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzed IPC stream data is parsed into a RecordBatch containing a ListArray/LargeListArray whose logical length is 0 but whose ArrayData offset is nonzero (or otherwise requires indexed access beyond available offsets). During reader.cc::FuzzIpcStream, batch->ValidateFull() calls ValidateListArray, which calls value_offset(0)/value_offset(length) even for empty arrays. Because ValidateOffsets skips size enforcement when length==0, malformed offset buffers are accepted and OOB read is triggered.
